other_conditions: The applicant must be a student in a class between Class 1st to 10th.
The applicant must be from a Minority Community.
The applicant must have secured not less than 50 % marks in the previous final examination.
The applicant must not be availing any other scholarship by the government.
The applicant must not be the third sibling in his/her family who has been given this scholarship.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance covering admission fee, tuition fee and maintenance allowance for minority students studying classes 1 to 10.
